title: Tokyo Restaurant Adds Space for Content Creators
paragraphs: Many people like to take photos and videos of their food and share them online. Now, a restaurant in Tokyo has made a special place just for them.

The restaurant is a branch of Yakiniku Like, a chain that serves yakiniku, or Japanese grilled meat. The branch is in Shinjuku, a short walk from Shinjuku Station. In October, the restaurant announced a new booth called "Studio Like."

The booth is made for content creators, people who make videos and photos for social media. It has a mirror with lights, so people can check their hair and makeup before filming. It also has places to hold cameras above the table, so people can film their food from the top. In addition, the booth has a background and walls around it.

The walls are useful for two reasons. First, they make the videos look better. Second, they give privacy to other customers, who may not want to appear in someone else's video. The restaurant also says that people are allowed to live-stream from the booth.

Yakiniku Like is a good place for this kind of seat. At most yakiniku restaurants, people sit at large tables in groups. But at Yakiniku Like, all the seats are at counters, and every customer has their own small grill. This makes it popular with people who eat alone. The Studio Like booth has one grill that is big enough for two people.
People can use the booth for 60 minutes at a time, between 11 a.m. and 9:30 p.m. They need to make a reservation through the restaurant's official LINE account.
The booth was created together with Maari Iwata, an actress, singer and influencer.
